notes.title: New World: Aeternum Update 1.3.27
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Adventurers![/h2]

New World: Aeternum Update 1.3.27 downtime will begin at 5:00 AM PT (1200 UTC) on June 3rd and last approximately 1.5 hours. 

Check out the full release notes, including other notable fixes, below.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/5WjyT9PeUbdmbihocgl6t2/7d032d374ca8a288ff0632bbbf1fba4f/NWA_S8AnnouncementScreenshots_EventRewards_Final_740x416_WEB_CT-000017375.jpg[/img]
[h3]Seasonal Server 2[/h3]

[list]
[*] Seasonal Server 2 is our take on a hardcore experience. We’ve built this to reward you for flexing your mastery and knowledge of the game. Additionally, we want to open up all the content for all our players in this time limited experience. The major changes we have made for this server are:
[*] No Main Questline - We’ve built a new, very expedited quest line to follow. This questline will give you all the experience needed for your character to reach maximum level in approximately 6 hours. It will also introduce you to the new mechanic we’re using for progressing your character on this server, Azerite Tailings.
[*] Azerite Tailings - Azerite Tailings are an item that can be dropped from multiple different locations in the world and can be used to craft new types of inventory caches for yourself. These caches will be much faster to use for gearing up your character on this server than standard loot drops. These caches can provide everything you need for your characters (such as consumables, gear, and even materials for selecting perks on artifacts.)
[*] Artifacts Unlimited - On this server, you are able to equip as many artifacts as you would like. We don’t know exactly how powerful these can become, but we want to allow you to experiment in some new ways and try some new gameplay combinations that even we haven’t seen before.
[*] Death Status Effects - A new status effect will be present on your character when created on this server for tracking your Unfallen or Fallen state, and this is our attempt at a different kind of hardcore experience. Characters who have not died will be considered ‘Unfallen’ and characters who have died will be considered ‘Fallen’. Instead of a traditional hardcore model, where your character is simply deleted on death, this status effect will stack up, granting 25 bonus attributes per stack. However, some challenges can only be completed in an Unfallen state.  Group up with others to tackle these objectives and remain Unfallen, but don’t be afraid to keep going if you do Fall, you’ll be getting stronger and stronger.
[*] War has its own unique status effect. This status effect will provide a higher potential stacking on attributes after death (as well as a damage bonus), but it also reduces your armor and absorptions while active (this is intended to help balance out some of the potential defensive power artifacts can provide). Since this is a time limited server, territory control is not the primary focus, so we wanted to give people an opportunity to experience the mode in a different way. Honestly, we’re hoping you will all go out into the field and bonk each other over the head with foam bats and cardboard tubes for a weekend.
[*] Earnable Rewards - You will be able to earn new rewards for your character by completing challenges in the Season Journey on this server. These new earnable rewards are Raw Orichalcite Stone which allows you to craft any artifact you want (out of all the artifacts you do not currently own), and Runewood Resin which allows you to craft any T3 trophy you want. There will also be new cosmetics and titles to earn throughout this experience. These rewards will not be claimable on your seasonal character and must be claimed on one of your primary characters.
[*] Important extra note about the Hardcore server: As the focus of this server is push the limit of characters to the max, including using full sets of artifacts in endgame content such as the Gorgon raid, players will be required to have the Rise of the Angry Earth expansion to participate.
[/list]

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/3xD3szaYdhfJ6qROLQqZDv/663ad2962eb063287f40d0656e3973f3/NWA_S8AnnouncementScreenshots_WorldBoss_Mahantaram_Final_1920x1080_WEB_CT-000017375.jpg[/img]
[h3]Expeditions Unleashed[/h3]

With the release of Expeditions Unleashed, we added a dynamic health scaling system for these encounters which will scale up and down the health of creatures and bosses in the encounter based on the number of players in the encounter area. This system has both a minimum and maximum boundary to the scaling and a per player increment. Our intention with this system is that more players should always be a benefit, but except in critically large player numbers, fight duration should be longer and more consistent than it was in past boss events. 

With our initial release we set our boundaries to fairly conservative numbers to ensure the system would not have a negative impact to server health due to the longer fights. After reviewing the data from live servers and player sentiment, we’ve seen a positive impact in fight duration within our boundaries but we are seeing significantly higher numbers of players than our upper limit and as a result, the effects of the system were not as impactful as we’d like versus very large  numbers of players (ie greater than 40). 

With this update we decided to increase that upper boundary to accommodate larger groups of players. We are making this change cautiously to avoid strain on the servers and, depending on the outcome, we may revisit these settings again in the future.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/5P9lPJrrjAqYtHxgHJNe84/33311dca90cbe72d271a48239e65df14/NWA_S8AnnouncementScreenshots_3V3Arena_A_Final_1920x1080_WEB_CT-000017375.jpg[/img]
[h3]Combat & Game Modes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Increased the bow's damage by 1.86% and musket by 1.68% in PvP.
[*] Upheaval - Reduced attack damage from 200% to 180% and reduced tactician upgrade CDR from 25% to 20%.
[*] Vampire's Vestments - Increased lifesteal amount from 10% to 17%.
[*] Lich Gloves - Increased empower (6% to 10%) and reduced cooldown (5s to 3s).
[*] Updated the Attuned Leather Pants and Old Crown to grant 11 attributes instead of 10.
[*] Vital Synergy - Reduced values for the stamina regen and healing bonus from 20% to 15%.
[*] Fixed an issue where target dummies could become 'immune' and no longer generate damage numbers.
[*] OPR - Buildable items are no longer allowed to be placed at the teleport locations through Gates and Barriers.
[*] Fixed an issue where Vital Synergy was reducing the power of the relentless artifact perk.
[*] Fixed an issue where Arenas didn't have the updated PvP damage values for Blunderbuss and Fire Staff.
[*] Fixed an issue where the hit boxes for mounts may not have been in the correct locations.
[*] Fixed an issue where rending stacks didn't have a cooldown allowing repeated activations per hit.
[/list]

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/63Vt0S7wlw8ylkkkIfKrlS/18ad00bfd9c6c7c28618c4025795ce51/NWA_S8AnnouncementScreenshots_WorldBoss_BlackPoweder_Final_1920x1080_WEB_CT-000017375.jpg[/img]
[h3]AI/Expeditions[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that allows players to climb onto Green keepers boulder attack, which would cause incorrect poison pool and boulder spawning.
[*] Fixed an issue where some of the Shielded Pistoleer in the world couldn’t be damaged or killed.
[*] Fixed an issue where Hive of the Gorgons sometimes couldn't be entered remotely.
[/list]

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/EQClnfObx0lgablctOadv/9ac1dee3b556293c3c147df724d0a534/NWA_S8AnnouncementScreenshots_WEB_CTF_A_Final_1920x1080_WEB_CT-000017375.jpg[/img]
[h3]General[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players were experiencing instability and crashes on PlayStation.
[*] Fixed an issue where PC players with the Rise of the Angry Earth expansion would see news to purchase it when logging into the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where auto-running after any melee attack and trying to perform a vault or mantle would fail.
[*] Fixed an issue where the character wouldn’t appear on the Character Select screen.
[*] Fixed some issues with the new rotational modes timers in the Activity Finder screen.
[*] Fixed an issue with the bottom-right queue status banner not being present when queuing for CTF.
[/list]

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/dvDwywDFwDp3eAPsMOelk/a295b70e429387fba33f283085224298/NWA_S8AnnouncementScreenshots_WorldBoss_Scarab_Final_1920x1080_WEB_CT-000017375.jpg[/img]
[h3]World[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the Sandwurm encounter that could cause players colliding with the Sandwurm to fall through the world or get stuck in geometry. The Sandwurm now has impassable collision and abilities that normally allow the player to pass through an enemy will not be able to pass through the Sandwurm.
[*] Fixed an issue where players might push the Sandwurm off of its intended position in the arena and negatively affect subsequent spawn locations and how the Sandwurm's abilities function.
[*] Adjusted spawn scaling bounds in Monarchs Bluff to address boar exploit.
[*] Fixed Wit's Quest pin for killing Monstrous Polyphemus directing players to the general POI rather than the Elite POI.
[/list]
Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Aeternum.

notes.title: New World: Aeternum: Capture the Flag Preview Weekend
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=2qRVEk_IiJU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Greetings Adventurers![/h3]

Capture the Flag is bringing fast, focused PvP action to New World: Aeternum. Get a first look at the new mode during a limited-time preview event: 

Preview Event Start: Friday, May 16
Preview Event End: Monday, May 19

Capture the Flag offers a new way to dive into intense, short-duration matches where quick decisions and sharp teamwork make all the difference. The goal behind Capture the Flag was simple: create a PvP mode that’s instantly understandable, endlessly replayable, and a true test of quick thinking under pressure.

[b]Pick a Role, Play Your Way[/b]
Every Capture the Flag match is a balance of offense, defense, and rapid adaptation. Players naturally fall into roles — carrier, defender, chaser, protector — but how you fill that role depends entirely on your team’s strategy and your build.

Carrying the flag isn’t easy. Slowed movement, increased incoming damage, and reduced healing keeps things balanced, while using certain movement abilities will cause you to drop the flag immediately. Every weapon loadout can run the flag, but not every loadout will survive the chase — smart play and teamwork are key.

[b]Battlefields Built for Speed[/b]
Both Capture the Flag maps were custom-designed to support the mode’s relentless energy.

They may look familiar, but every jump pad, corridor, and power-up placement was crafted to keep fights tight and thrilling.

On the field, players will find:
[list]
[*] Power-ups — grab boosts to health, speed, or damage at critical moments.
[*] Jump pads — launch yourself into chaotic new angles of attack.
[*] No base defenses — defense is your responsibility.
[/list]

With near-instant respawns, downtime is nearly nonexistent—keeping pressure high from the moment you grab the flag to the moment you fight your way back to home base to score.
Speed Meets Strategy

[b]Capture the Flag is quick to learn and satisfying to master.[/b]

The mode’s simplicity makes it perfect for casual players looking for instant action, but smart coordination and team synergy will define the winners.

Development for Capture the Flag wasn’t without its challenges. Tuning pickup timers, flag drop mechanics, and spawn protections took significant iteration — and the flexibility built into the mode’s backend will allow for ongoing live adjustments as the playerbase shapes how Capture the Flag is played.

Early versions of the mode experimented with twists on the traditional format, but the decision to start with a classic Capture the Flag experience sets the stage for future variant modes and experiments in coming seasons.

[b]Play for Glory (and Loot)[/b]
During Season 8’s Preview Weekends, Capture the Flag will reward players with standard Outpost Rush crates.

There aren’t exclusive cosmetics or achievements tied to the mode yet — but capture the flag based rewards are already being explored for Season 9 and beyond.

For now, the goal is pure: victory, bragging rights, and endless clutch moments.
Build for the Fight

While Capture the Flag’s arenas are set in recognizable parts of Aeternum, they’re competitive spaces first — designed for flow, tactics, and nonstop motion.

To bring the mode to life, the team built:
[list]
[*] Custom-designed flags and power-up visuals
[*] New jump pad assets
[*] A fully voiced announcer hyping every clutch play
[*] Original music composed to match the pace of battle
[/list]

It’s a fresh, kinetic experience inside a world players already know.

[b]The Race Begins[/b]
Capture the Flag is fast, brutal, tactical, and just getting started.

Preview Weekends arrive in Season 8 — your first chance to sprint, defend, steal, and score before the mode goes live permanently.

Grab your team, sharpen your builds, and get ready to run. We’ll see you in Aeternum!

notes.title: Season 8: Season of the Divide - Release Notes
notes.content:
Season 8 begins May 13 at 5:00AM PT (1:00PM UTC) with the launch of Season of the Divide, a massive update packed with PvP experimentation, combat overhaul, and the debut of hardcore seasonal servers. Whether you’re chasing leaderboard glory in new game modes, testing your skill in permadeath adventures, or perfecting your build with Artifact upgrades and balance changes — there’s more to fight for than ever before.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/3rrw07V1aeSm2Y4WOPCugn/b11a023f1b30599854523932716964ec/NWA_S8AnnouncementScreenshots_WEB_CTF_A_Final_1920x1080_WEB_CT-000017375.jpg[/img]

[b]New PvP Modes & Maps[/b]

Capture the Flag, Outpost Rush: Barebones, and a new Arena map join the roster during limited-time preview events. You’ll also find a permanent addition in Coral Divide, a vertical, ocean-themed Outpost Rush map with strategic fort clashes and redesigned objectives.

PvP map rotations are now hourly, and new features like PvP Camps, team UI, and pre-match Ready Up deepen the tactical layer of each fight.


[b]Hardcore Seasonal Server[/b]

Coming in June, Hardcore Mode redefines risk vs reward. Death wipes your best rewards, and only the strongest earn full Seasonal Journey completion. Faster leveling, streamlined crafting, and limited-time exclusive cosmetics and gear materials await.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/7rF7qyqQL1Ta5FuH4ozWJx/fce547244f56d00a17a9334bfdb59624/NWA_S8_The_Divide_Artifacts_Final_1920x1080_CT-000017372.jpg[/img]
[b]Artifacts, Perks, and Combat[/b]

Seven new Artifacts enter the endgame alongside new perks, gem types, and combat balance for every weapon. PvE and PvP values are now more clearly separated, and powerful new survival potions shift how players stay alive in high-stakes encounters.


[b]Quality of Life & Systems[/b]
Expect a smarter Target Lock system, streamlined mutator rewards, the long-requested Barbershop, and more intuitive controls for both controller and keyboard players. Behind the scenes, DX12 is now the default renderer on PC, with DLSS 4 support added for RTX users.

Expeditions, UI, and Fixes

Every expedition has seen tuning, bug fixes, or both — from collision and VFX issues to raid boss behaviors and loot consistency. Over 100 bugs have been squashed, including input fixes, social UI bugs, and combat desyncs.

Season of the Divide is just getting started. Jump in May 13, test new PvP experiences, and prepare for what’s next. Read the complete release notes [url=https://www.newworld.com/en-us/game/releases/season-of-the-divide]here[/url].

notes.title: Season of the Divide: Artifact Deep Dive
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Adventurers![/h2]
Season 8 introduces a powerful new set of Artifacts. Whether you aim to sprint across the battlefield, outlast your foes, or sap their strength with forbidden magic, these gear pieces unlock new tactical layers for every playstyle. 

Let’s take a look at the new additions.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/7rF7qyqQL1Ta5FuH4ozWJx/fce547244f56d00a17a9334bfdb59624/NWA_S8_The_Divide_Artifacts_Final_1920x1080_CT-000017372.jpg[/img]


[h3]OLD CROWN – MEDIUM HEADWEAR[/h3]
Once worn by an ancient ruler of Aeternum, the Old Crown is a majestic helm focused on versatility and durability. With its triple gems and balanced stat line, it’s perfect for hybrid builds that need elemental and physical resistances without sacrificing attributes.
Royal: +10 to all Attributes.
Gem Slot: Energizing Spectral Ward.
Immaculate Onyx: +3% Physical Absorption.
Immaculate Opal: +3% Elemental Absorption.
How to get: Available through Seasonal Activities and Elite Chests in Elysian Wilds.

[h3]VAMPIRE’S VESTMENTS – LIGHT CHEST[/h3]
Designed for mages and lifesteal builds, Vampire’s Vestments allow you to trade mana for raw sustain in combat. It rewards ability-based pressure while ensuring your resource pool stays active through smart basic attack use.
Drain: Hitting a target consumes 10 mana. If mana is spent this way, that hit grants 10% lifesteal. If using a magic weapon, only abilities trigger lifesteal while basic attacks restore 10 mana (0.5s cooldown).
Gem Slot: Slotable.
How to get: Earned from Season Pass Rewards or found in Arcane Tempest chests.

[h3]LICH GLOVES – LIGHT HANDS[/h3]
These gloves are a perfect fit for spellcasters who love to stack power before unleashing a flurry of light attacks. Time your bursts well to maximize Empower bonuses before your next basic strike.
Curse: Activating an ability grants +4% Empower for 7s (stacks to 3). All stacks are lost on basic attack (cannot gain new stacks for 5s after losing them).
Gem Slot: Slotable.
How to get: Dropped from Season 8 Elite Trial Bosses.

[h3]RUNIC GREAVES – HEAVY FEET[/h3]
Built with speed glyphs embedded in the plating, Runic Greaves offer tanks and bruisers a moment of mobility after deploying their Heartrune. An excellent option for closing gaps or making a tactical escape.
Expeditious: Activating a Heartrune grants 33% Move Speed for 7s.
Gem Slot: Slotable.
How to get: Available from Seasonal Activity Card and Faction Vendor Cache (Rank 5+).

[h3]CHAOS – BLUNDERBUSS[/h3]
A brutal weapon for area denial and explosive mayhem. Chaos turns Blast Shot into a battlefield nuke, flinging ignited enemies through enemy lines for devastating cleave potential.
Chaos Blast: Blast Shot gains +300% push distance. The first target hit is ignited and becomes a projectile, dealing 50% weapon damage to all enemies they pass through.
Gem Slot: Slotable.
How to get: Earned by defeating the Flamebound Shaman in the Flamecaller Outpost.

[h3]WIT – LONGSWORD[/h3]
Wit is a clever twist on classic tank play, amplifying threat generation and punishing foes who dare strike back. Its insult-laced edge draws aggro like a magnet while softening incoming blows.
Snide Remarks: Taunts are active. Light attack critical hits generate 250% more threat. On crit, reduce hostile AI’s base damage to you by 15% for 3s.
Gem Slot: Slotable.
How to get: Dropped from Seasonal Expedition Bosses or found in Honorable Ward Chests.

[h3]RELENTLESS – TOWER SHIELD[/h3]
Relentless is the embodiment of unshakable support. While sacrificing some of your own defenses, you empower nearby allies with massive armor boosts and gain increased healing intake for long-lasting frontline resilience.
Altruism: While in combat, nearby allies gain +35% Armor. You receive +20% increased incoming healing (excluding lifesteal and consumables). Your own Armor is reduced by 20%.
Gem Slot: Slotable.
How to get: Found in Season 8 Influence Race Reward Caches.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/6cr0VZ2TOLo8ATn6lfPSa6/4774f74a740e9db3a34d9224830c2b4a/NWA_S8_The_Divide_Hero_Final_1920x1080_CT-000017372.jpg[/img]


Which Artifact are you building around this season? Let us know — and we’ll see you in Aeternum.

notes.title: Season 8 – “Season of the Divide” Announcement
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/6ahQRkNtWfFD7ejXPyLhf6/ec6d397bb76ba6f3e34057768fa5e9d6/NWA_The_Divide_S8_Final_1920x1080_CT-000016266.jpg[/img]
[h1]Greetings, Adventurers![/h1]

Survival or supremacy. Rebirth or ruin. These are the choices that define Season of the Divide, the latest seasonal update coming to New World on May 13. This season throws players into fierce competition with a focus on high-stakes risk, fast progression, and massive PvP encounters. Prepare for a Hardcore Seasonal World, the new Coral Divide Outpost Rush map, World Bosses, preview weekends for Capture the Flag and 3v3 Arena, a new Barbershop, and more. Whether you’re sprinting to max level or risking it all to remain “unfallen”, Season 8 rewards those who embrace the chaos—and survive it.

[h2]What’s New in Season 8 – “Season of the Divide”[/h2]

[h3]Hardcore Seasonal World[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/7mUT7slkvt5BajZ5zAfpj5/94a02f45d149343d879dd170c86d9770/NWA_S8AnnouncementScreenshots_3V3Arena_A_Final_1920x1080_WEB_CT-000017375.jpg[/img]

Speed. Strategy. Survival.

This season’s Seasonal World, Hardcore, introduces a thrilling twist to character progression. New characters begin in a “unfallen” state, gaining access to elite rewards if they survive without dying. Die once, and you will forfeit the ability to unlock the unfallen rewards. However, your character will remain, and your experience on the server will become easier. You’ll still have plenty of other rewards to chase and unlock for your account and primary characters, even after you’ve fallen. If you’ve never experienced some of the pinnacle group content, or struggled to find a group, this server is the perfect place to power up and dive into that content with ease.

Leveling and gearing up is faster than ever in this limited-time world with a completely different, streamlined main questline to follow. Artifact equip limits are lifted, allowing players to power up like never before. Push yourself to the brink or reroll to reclaim your unfallen glory. The choice is yours.

The Season 8 Hardcore Seasonal World will will only be available for a limited time and launch in early June. Look forward to more details closer to launch.


[h3]Outpost Rush New Map - Coral Divide[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/5vW5SpiCrMwFXB37Jg2gpL/a880b1f33d9d023927c6fadeb308a27c/NWA_S8AnnouncementScreenshots_OPR_A_Final_1920x1080_WEB_CT-000017375.jpg[/img]

The Coral Divide Outpost Rush map makes its debut this season. Fight for control in a vibrant, ocean-themed arena designed to emphasize verticality, tactical flank routes, and intense center fort clashes.


[h3]PvP New Modes and Maps Preview Events[/h3]

During Season 8 we will host a number of preview events featuring new PvP modes and new maps for existing PvP modes. These limited time events occur throughout Season 8 and each will be active for several days. Exact dates for the preview events will be shared during the season. 

[h3]Capture the Flag Preview[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/3rrw07V1aeSm2Y4WOPCugn/b11a023f1b30599854523932716964ec/NWA_S8AnnouncementScreenshots_WEB_CTF_A_Final_1920x1080_WEB_CT-000017375.jpg[/img]

Capture the Flag is a new PvP mode coming to New World: Aeternum that players will have a chance to test during Season 8. This exciting new mode pits two teams of 10 players against each other in a fast-paced fight to control the team’s flag. Score as many captures as you can in the limited time to win. Powerups and Jump Pads in this mode make it feel more competitive and unlike any other PvP mode in the game. We look forward to sharing all the details about this new mode before our test events, so stay tuned!

[h3]Outpost Rush: Barebones Preview[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/l4PZUzsGcdSnKYU47SGok/6c1e72a3c9a5588b983624434ec914a7/NWA_S8AnnouncementScreenshots_OPR_B_Final_1920x1080_WEB_CT-000017375.jpg[/img]

Outpost Rush: Barebones is a new spin on our most popular game mode that attempts to level the playing field completely. In this version, all gear perks are disabled and everyone is bumped up to max gear score. If you feel like your gear isn’t good enough for PvP or want to prove that you’re better than your gear, join us!

[h3]3v3 Arena Map Preview[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/6IxuxzGGjpbVi4LCxrDHWM/94d98a5ad777ba46cd1986ca74446118/NWA_S8AnnouncementScreenshots_3V3Arena_B_Final_1920x1080_WEB_CT-000017375.jpg[/img]

We will also preview our latest offering for 3v3 Arenas that features our largest arena to date set in an ancient temple grove. The death fog closes in sooner in this map causing an early ranged advantage to quickly become a melee advantage.

[h3]Expeditions Unleashed: World Bosses[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/50aZuRexNQePkwAcEdGQ4s/1533e7e99b258366da0325d248995fca/NWA_S8AnnouncementScreenshots_WorldBoss_Mahantaram_Final_1920x1080_WEB_CT-000017375.jpg[/img]

Take on colossal threats during limited-time, open-world events featuring iconic enemies from Expeditions. Players can rally together to defeat level 70 bosses for up-leveled loot (GS 715–725). Each event grants one guaranteed 725 GS item and multiple 710+ items. Look forward to the bosses Mammoth Mahantaram, Scarab Boss Khepri, and Fire Naga Ifrit making appearances during Season 8.

[h3]Barbershop[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/6VPWsuihANs7XKftOfFqJM/c025d7cfb7c472adcefd0b04ad2cb9eb/NWA_S8AnnouncementScreenshots_Barbershop_Final_1920x1080_WEB_CT-000017375.jpg[/img]

Reimagine your character at the Barbershop, available now at every Stylemancer! Use Barbershop Tokens—earnable through gameplay or purchasable in the Store—to tweak your appearance. All players can earn a free token in the Season Pass!

[h3]Seasonal Events & Bonuses[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/3TAGCGTbMPY1YJnELalk4e/8e1a5072cea0387c8752e916830c04b2/NWA_S8AnnouncementScreenshots_EventRewards_Final_1920x1080_WEB_CT-000017375.jpg[/img]

[b]Springtide Bloom[/b]
Celebrate renewal with refreshed rewards and seasonal cosmetics.

[b]Faction Fest: Expeditions[/b]
Choose a Faction, compete in themed activities, and earn rewards.

[b]Fury of the Spriggan[/b]
Battle nature’s wrath with updated event rewards.

[b]XP Boost Events[/b]

* Weapons (PvE & PvP) 
* Gathering (PvE) 

[h3]Season Pass Rewards[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/1hanS2BRn20yELr84tg689/d5e13600c06b16576f31d44142b4e241/NWA_S8AnnouncementScreenshots_RewardTrack_Helmets_Final_1920x1080_WEB_CT-000017375.jpg[/img]

[b]Free Track[/b]

[list]
[*] 2 Artifacts: Lich Gloves & Vampire Vestments
[*] 6 Tool Skins: Sinner’s Set
[*] 2 Helm Skins: Oblivion’s Herald & Corruption’s Witness
[*] 5 Sets of Dyes
[*] Emotes: Brush Off Shoulder, Touch Grass
[/list]

[b]Premium Track (20,000 Marks of Fortune)[/b]
[list]
[*] 9 Weapon Skins: Fallen Set
[*] 5 Armor Skins: Blackguard Set
[*] 5 Additional Dye Sets
[/list]

[h3]New Artifacts[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/1XCN9xgDcGb4IJT77effA4/4000c762b771519b39af4c5077810a5a/NWA_S8AnnouncementScreenshots_RewardTrack_Armor_Final_1920x1080_WEB_CT-000017375.jpg[/img]
Season 8 delivers 7 powerful new artifacts, including:

* Old Crown (Head) – +10 to all attributes, comes with bonus gem functionality
* Relentless (Tower Shield) – Team armor aura and enhanced healing.
* Vampire Vestments (Light Chest) – Lifesteal and mana synergy.
* Wit (Sword) – Increased threat and damage mitigation on crits.
* Chaos (Blunderbuss) – Launch enemies with fiery blast shots.
* Runic Greaves (Heavy Feet) – Speed boost after using Heartrunes.
* Lich Gloves (Light Hands) – Empower stacking with ability usage.

[h3]Tech Enhancements[/h3]

[list]
[*] Improved performance and visuals for Nvidia GPUs.
[*] DirectX 12 – Enabled by default on Steam for better stability and graphics.
[/list]

[h3]Combat & Quality of Life Updates[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/1MtEDi18n0bYS7vBSEHTTE/388f0540c04b80cb0d9221e82b89593d/NWA_S8AnnouncementScreenshots_WEB_CTF_B_Final_1920x1080_WEB_CT-000017375.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] PVP Camps - Open world PvP is getting an upgrade! Players flagged for PvP will now be able to place or bind to faction only destructible camps. Hunt down and destroy enemy faction camps to remove your enemy’s ability to respawn close to the fight, creating a more strategic experience in Influence Races and open world PvP combat.
[*] Ready Up – Start PvP matches faster when enough players opt in.
[*] Spectator Cam – Watch the battle after death in select game modes.
[*] Survival Potions – 5 new potions to choose between to modify different aspects of survivability in combat.
[/list]
    * Burst Regen Potion - A small burst of healing followed by a passive regen for a duration (Combination of Health and Regen potions)
    * Health Shot Potion - Similar to a health potion but provides with less healing, but can be used more often
    * Shield Potion - Grants damage reduction for 3 hits taken, lasts until timer runs out or until the hits are taken
    * Grit Potion - Grants the uninterruptible effect for the duration
    * Lifesteal Potion - Increases the power of all lifesteal effects for the duration.
[list]
[*] Target Lock Updates - Target lock and aim assist were added primarily to assist controller players to compete with mouse and keyboard aiming, but when combined they made aiming almost completely unnecessary. In retrospect, we feel that removing aiming as a necessity on controller harmed the skilled nature of our combat so we’ve made some changes to target lock to bring back the skill.
[/list]
    * We’ve reduced the amount of aim assist you receive when locked onto enemy players on controller, making it harder to hit moving targets, but have also tuned aim assist to work better with controller outside of target lock. The goal was for target lock to still be useful in certain situations, but players must now manage it more actively since it isn’t as simple as just locking on a target and expecting everything to hit.
    * Target lock now breaks when your target moves behind the camera. This was changed to add more counter-play to target lock as you can dodge through someone to break their lock and it’s now more difficult to track a target that is actively trying to disengage your lock.
    * Target lock also now breaks when entering aim down sights.
    * We’ll be keeping an eye on this feature in the future and will make more tweaks to dial things in as needed.

Stay tuned for more information in upcoming deep dives and release notes as we approach launch. We’ll see you in Aeternum.

notes.title: New World: Aeternum Update 1.3.0.5
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Adventurers![/h2]


New World Update 1.3.0.5 downtime will begin at 11:00 p.m. PT (7:00 a.m. UTC) on April 14 and last approximately 1.5 hours. This update brings back a seasonal favorite, improvements to Outpost Rush: Coral Divide, and a variety of gameplay fixes to enhance your experience across Aeternum. Here are the highlights you won’t want to miss:


[h3]Events[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/5LVvaFpI5ItCI1ExZFjAah/52b5a8d16d00fab76814664711d989ed/NWA_Rabbits_Revenge_25_Explosion_1920x1080_CT-000017322.jpg[/img]

[b]Rabbit’s Revenge[/b]
Something wicked this way hops. Starting April 15 - May 13, Corrupted Rabbits return to Aeternum — twisted, feral, and hungry for chaos. Hunt them across the wilds to earn exclusive loot, including the new Corrupted Rabbit’s Armor set (legs, gloves, boots) and complete your look with the all-new Corruption’s Rabbit Helm in the store.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/2pgrVuCFijqk1SvA3obodH/9702800cd2eef96fe6722b2e105f8d83/NWA_OPR_Map_Final_1920x1080.jpg[/img]
[b]Outpost Rush: Coral Divide Preview 2[/b]

Thanks again for joining us in the last preview of our newest Outpost Rush map Coral Divide! We’ve taken your feedback and suggestions and have made key changes and fixes to help with the playability of the map. Join us again for a second preview from April 15th - April 22nd.

Changes made for this preview:

[list]
[*] Cleaned up the environment collision to aid in navigating the map.
[*] Removed vegetation to help with visibility and performance.
[*] Adjusted fort entrances so they are equally distant from Sol outpost, allowing both teams to arrive at the same time.
[*] Adjusted lighting to reduce saturation and improve visibility throughout the map.
[*] Reduced the cost of buildable bridges to 40 stone/40 wood and made them buildable from both sides.
[*] Removed the barriers leading to Baroness.
[*] Adjusted the subterranean areas of the map to improve visibility.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed player to mantle wall of Star Outpost in the original Outpost Rush.
[*] Fixed an issue where players were able to platform into Sol & Astra outposts, bypassing the gates.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Outpost Luna icons in Trench to not appear when zoomed in.
[*] Fixed issues where the terrain was raised above the ground in multiple areas.
[/list]

[h3]AGiD (Amazon Games ID)[/h3]

You’ll be prompted on login to link your account with an AGiD via QR code. This is not required, but if you link your account, you’ll receive some rewards for your effort! Please note that linking your account will permanently tie all game progress and purchases to your Amazon Games iD.

[h3]Notable Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] We are currently looking into the cause of VFX culling across Aeternum and have implemented changes that will resolve some of these VFX culling issues, but not all of them. This is a high priority for our team, so we will continue to dive into this to provide a full fix.
[*] Fixed an issue with body blocking in raids on PvP servers when players are differing factions
[*] Fixed an issue causing Typhon to sometimes remain in phase two when phase three is initiated.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed players to activate Hatchet's Berserk ability without playing its animation.
[*] Fixed the Season Pass 'Hail to the King Seasonal World Bonus Challenge' Task not mentioning you need a melee weapon equipped for the challenge to be completed.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support! We’ll see you in Aeternum.

notes.title: New World: Aeternum Update 1.3.0.0
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/2aYirTpcCFS2I3wvfIiL2d/fb442556cb3f3cafa514e0b72dec3ffe/NWA_Legacy_of_Carassus_Final_1920x1080_CT-000016852.jpg[/img]
[h2]Greetings, Adventurers![/h2]

New World: Aeternum Update 1.3.0.0 downtime will begin at 11:00 p.m. PT (7:00 a.m. UTC) on March 10th and last approximately 1.5 hours. The latest update brings a host of improvements to combat, seasonal events, and the overall player experience. Here are some of the most notable changes adventurers can look forward to:
[h3]Combat Enhancements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fire Staff: The Incinerate ability now properly displays visual effects.
[*] Void Gauntlet: The Harvester’s Retribution effect from the Conqueror’s perk no longer lasts indefinitely.
[*] Dodge Mechanics: Fixed an issue that prevented magic weapon light attacks from firing when canceling from a dodge.
[*] War Boards: Resolved a bug where war boards could appear blank during an invasion or war.
[*] Consumables: The Cleansing Elixir buff now correctly disappears after leaving Outpost Rush.
[/list]
[h3]Seasonal & Economy Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players can now lock items dropped from the Siege of Sulfur Spoils Boxes.
[*] The Mystery Box from the Seasonal World Bonus chapter is now accessible on non-seasonal worlds.
[*] Adjusted Season Pass tasks to ensure they can only be completed in seasonal worlds.
[/list]
[h3]Expeditions & World Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Expedition VFX improvements ensure boss effects remain visible, even with lower GFX settings.
[*] The PUG Finder for Normal Expeditions now only gates entry based on level, rather than Gear Score, preventing players from artificially lowering their GS.
[/list]
[h3]UX & Performance Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] UI Stability: Fixed an issue where all UI elements could disappear when reconnecting to the game after leaving Outpost Rush.
[*] Audio Settings: Added a slider to adjust the Target Lock sound effect volume.
[*] Trading Post Filtering: Items now properly filter down as intended.
[*] Collision Fixes: Resolved unintended collision issues in PvE raids and expeditions, which had been disrupting quest progression.
[/list]

[h3]Combat/AI [/h3]
[b]Weapons [/b]
[list]
[*] Hatchet: Fixed an issue that allowed players to activate Berserk without playing its animation.
[*] Heartgems :Fixed an issue where some effects of primal fury could get applied indefinitely.
[/list]
[b]Game Modes[/b]
[list]
[*] War: Fixed an issue where players could climb into war camps.
[/list]

[h3]Perks[/h3]
[b]Balance Changes: [/b]
[list]
[*] We have some backend functionality that reduces the attacker's block stamina damage dealt for 0.5s after taking a hit. Previously the value was a 25% reduction, but we have changed that to be 13% reduction.
[/list]

[b]The Wall Artifact — Chromatic Ward Perk:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced elemental base damage reduction from 25% to 13%.
[*] Reduced the power of the Refreshing ward perk on older named items that were at 625 GS or lower.
[*] Reduced the base damage reduction while grit is active for the 350 CON Attribute Threshold from 10% to 7%.
[*] Added a 1s cooldown timer to the Tower Shield functionality of the One With the Shield passive for the Sword and Shield.
[*] Changed the tower shield portion of the final countdown portion of defender's resolve to be a fortify instead of base damage reduction.
[*] Added a 15s cooldown to the sturdy energy perk increased the cooldown of the stamina recovery perk to 60s.
[/list]
[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a potential client crash when selecting healing targets via Raid Hud.
[*] Fixed an issue where ranged attacks would often miss crawling Ancient Guardians when using Target Lock.
[/list]
[h3]Economy/Progression[/h3]
[b]Gear/Items[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing the two new artifacts, Fracture and Otzi, to use the wrong floating attachments. They should now display the correct floating accessory when equipped by a player.
[/list]
[b]Trade Skills - Crafting[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players were unable to craft material-related recipes.
[/list]
[h3]World Experience[/h3] 
[b]Season Pass[/b]
[list]
[*] Clarified the requirements for the Trio of Trials Season Journey Task.
[/list]
[b]Seasonal Event[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Signifer Nerva could animate incorrectly when starting the Legacy of Crassus event.
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3] 
[b]Notable Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the respawn screen may not show up for players.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could not rebind Numpad 0 on their keyboards.
[/list]
[h3]Social [/h3]
[b]Emotes[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed description and action text for the Stumble Home Walk emote.
[/list]
[h3]UX/UI [/h3]
[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Addressed issue where raid group members sometimes display as white indicators on the respawn screen.
[*] Fix Fresh Start Server Icon displaying along with Seasonal Server Icon.
[*] Fixed being able to attempt transfer from a Fresh-Start World to a Seasonal Server.
[/list]
[h3]In-Game Store[/h3]
[list]
[*] Limited-time timer no longer overlaps the title of store item.
[/list]
With these updates, we’re continuing to refine your experience. Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Aeternum.

notes.title: Forged in Aeternum - Recap Outpost Rush (OPR): Coral Divide
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=afuI01bE41c;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Greetings, Adventurers![/h2]

The Coral Divide Outpost Rush (OPR) preview weekend was a smash hit! With so many players jumping in, the excitement was real—so much so that a lot of you just wanted the map turned on as-is. But of course, we took your feedback and are making some key tweaks before launch. 

[h3]What’s Changing?[/h3]

[b]General Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Map Size Adjustment – Reducing unnecessary open space to keep engagements dynamic and fast-paced.
[*] Terrain Optimization – Smoothing out rough terrain and obstacles that disrupt movement and combat.
[*] Improved Visibility – Adjustments to lighting, foliage, and environmental clutter to enhance clarity.
[/list]

[b]Objective and Balance Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Resource Node Placement Tweaks – Relocating and balancing resource nodes to ensure fair access for both teams.
[*] Fortifications Adjustments – Modifying outpost defenses to prevent excessive turtling or overpowered positions.
[*] Updated Spawn Locations – Refining respawn points to reduce spawn camping and unfair positioning.
[*] Revised Capture Mechanics – Improving interaction points for smoother and more intuitive captures.
[/list]

[b]Combat & Engagement Enhancements[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted Line of Sight – Reducing frustrating sniper spots while maintaining strategic positioning.
[*] Better Combat Flow – Enhancing chokepoints and engagement areas for more balanced fights.
[*] More Cover Options – Adding or repositioning cover elements to prevent open-field vulnerability.
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Minimap Enhancements – Updating icons and labels for better clarity on objectives and player locations.
[*] Bug Fixes & Performance Optimizations – Addressing player-reported issues affecting gameplay stability and fairness
[/list].

[h3]Coral Divide Returns for an Extended Preview Week[/h3]

You asked for more time to test the changes — so we’re bringing Coral Divide back for an entire preview week:

[list]
[*] Start: Tuesday, April 15, at 10:00 a.m. (PT)
[*] End: Monday, April 21, at 10:00 a.m. (PT)
[/list]

To participate, open the Activity Finder and queue for Outpost Rush during the event window. Join the discussion in the official Discord to share your feedback on the new updates to the map. We look forward to hearing from you and we’ll see you in Aeternum!

notes.title: Legacy of Crassus - March 2025
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/6GYINajal5F72NFjkha2Tc/007ea556e23168a9131b01ac362d3de6/NWA_Legacy_of_Crassus_Final_1920x1080_EN_CT-000016851.jpg[/img]

[h2]Greetings, Adventurers![/h2]

The battle is more intense than ever—Crassus is stronger, more relentless, and will test your strength like never before. But with greater challenges come even greater rewards—rise to the fight and reap the spoils. Prepare for an extra week of battle and enhanced rewards, including new GS 710 versions of Crassus’ loot!

[h3]Event Updates & New Rewards[/h3]

[b]Extended Battle Period[/b]

The Legacy of Crassus event will now run for an additional week, giving players more time to take on Crassus’ forces and earn rewards. The event will now conclude on March 31, 2025.

[b]Loot System Enhancements[/b]

We’ve improved the loot drops to ensure more meaningful progression:

[list]
[*] New Gear Score 710 Loot: We’ve introduced GS 710 versions of Crassus’ exclusive weapons and armor, giving players even more powerful rewards.
[*] Loot Limiter for Balance: To maintain fairness and challenge, players can only earn one GS 710 item per day.
[/list]
[b]Reward Spotlight[/b]

Triumph over these level 70 vicious brutes for event-specific items like Cyclops Statuettes, the 19th Legion Pickaxe, Lucanus weapons, and Decimus armor. Note that players must deal at least 1000 damage to receive rewards.

Each run gives you a Normal Box (Unlimited) and a Bonus Box (3/day)
Normal boxes have:

[list]
[*] a GS700 random Weapon, Armor, or Shield
[*] a Black Gypsum (~3/day)
[*] a Perk Item (Brilliant Animus, Sliver of Consecrated Iron, Shard of Consecrated Iron, Drop of Corrupted Essence, Huge Elk Hoof, IronwoodSapT1, Starmetal Weaponsmith's Charm, Whetstone, Squirming Vines)
[*] 2-3 Potions
[/list]
[b]Bonus boxes have:[/b]

[list]
[*] a GS700 Crassus Named Item (Wrath of Decimus, Hoplites Great Blade, Sagittar of Lucanus, Vesuvius, Galea of Lucanus, Cuirass of Decimus, Fists of Decimus, Braccae of Lucanus, Hobnailed Boots of Lucanus)
[*] a 2nd GS700 Crassus Named Item (33% Chance)
[*] 15 Dark Matter
[*] a GS710 Crassus Named Item (30% chance) (1/week)
[*] 9th Legion Pickaxe (2.5% Chance) (1/event)
[*] Cyclops Lucanus Statuette (2.5% Chance) (1/event)
[*]  Cyclops Decimus Statuette (2.5% Chance) (1/event)
[/list]
[b]After opening 8 boxes, you'll get a pity drop of:[/b]

[list]
[*] 1 GS710 Named Item (still locked by the 1/week limit)
[*] the 19th Legion Pickaxe (still locked at 1/event)
[*] Cyclops Lucanus Statuette (still locked at 1/event)
[*] Cyclops Decimus Statuettes (still locked at 1/event)
[/list]
Daily rewards reset at 5 AM local time. For example, if a player grabs one special cache at 4:58 AM, they’ll be able to earn another at 5:01 AM.

[b]STANDARD REWARDS[/b]

Players will receive one of the following rewards each time they fell Lucanus and Decimus. Unlike daily bonus rewards, players can slay the world boss multiple times in one day for additional rewards.

 Each victory rewards players with either:

[list]
[*] A random weapon or armor piece at their level (90% chance)
[*] A special Named item from Brimstone Sands or greater Aeternum (10% chance)
[*] Players will also get some level-appropriate consumables (health, mana, etc.)
[/list]
Are you ready to claim your legacy? We’ll see you in Aeternum!

notes.title: Coral Divide Preview Weekend: A First Look at a New Outpost Rush Map
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/2pgrVuCFijqk1SvA3obodH/9702800cd2eef96fe6722b2e105f8d83/NWA_OPR_Map_Final_1920x1080.jpg[/img]

[h2]Greetings, Adventurers![/h2]

Prepare for an exciting opportunity to be among the first to experience the newest battleground for Outpost Rush: Coral Divide! The Coral Divide preview weekend will run:

[list]
[*] Start: Friday, February 7, at 6:00 PM (UTC) 
[*] End: Monday, February 10, at 3:00 PM (UTC)
[/list]

During this exclusive event, you’ll have the chance to queue for Outpost Rush through the Activity Finder and test out this visually stunning and strategically challenging new map.

[h3]What to Expect:[/h3]

Coral Divide takes Outpost Rush to a new level, introducing a fresh location filled with unique features and opportunities for epic battles. Inspired by player feedback, for example, this map is smaller with fewer direct paths between the outposts, features less wide open areas, and has more controlled sightlines, which aim to create a more balanced and exciting experience. Our design team has worked tirelessly through the stages of concept creation, building, testing, and iteration to bring this new battlefield to life.

[h3]Rewards for Playing[/h3]

This weekend isn’t just about previewing Coral Divide, it’s also about awesome rewards! Players who join and complete a match each day during the event will receive:

[list]
[*] Feb 7th: Season XP Booster
[*] Feb 8th: Gathering XP Booster
[*] Feb 9th: Season XP Booster
[*] Feb 10th: Weapon XP Booster
[/list]

Additionally, participants will earn one Gold Cursed Coconut per day for completing a match. These coveted items will be delivered during the Legacy of Crassus Event.

[b]Twitch Drops:[/b]

Earn rewards by watching Twitch streams! The campaign is time-based, allowing you to unlock all items simultaneously by watching 8 hours of eligible streams during the event. Rewards include:

[list]
[*] Vial of Suspended Azoth (x10)
[*] Dark Matter (x50)
[*] Gypsum Orb (x5)
[*] Banana Parfait (x50)
[*] Regeneration Serum (x50)
[*] Powerful Proficiency Boost (x35)
[*] Be sure to link your Twitch account to claim these rewards via the Twitch Drops page.
[/list]

[h3]How to Join during the Preview Weekend:[/h3]

1. Open the Activity Finder and queue for Outpost Rush during the event window.
2. Play and complete matches daily on the Coral Divide map to earn maximum rewards.
3. Rewards will be distributed after the preview weekend ends.

[h3]Why a Test Weekend?[/h3]

The Coral Divide preview is an essential step in refining the map before its full release. This weekend is an opportunity to gather valuable player feedback, which will guide further adjustments and improvements. The team is eager to hear your thoughts and insights as you dive into this new battleground. Join in the discussion in the Official Discord to share your feedback. 

[h3]Mark Your Calendars[/h3]

Don’t miss this chance to be part of Aeternum history. Rally your allies, ready your weapons, and prepare to explore the Coral Divide. We can’t wait to see you on the battlefield and hear your feedback as we continue to shape the future of Outpost Rush!

We’ll see you in Coral Divide!

tags.feature: Coral Divide takes Outpost Rush to a new level, introducing a fresh location filled with unique features and opportunities for epic battles.

notes.title: Siege of Sulfur 2025
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/37xw8uippsFtvZ2FncO3s2/47f6c7c00cb35f4bdd1b6902f6b63a9a/NWA_Siege_of_Sulfur_EN_1920x1080_CT-000015923.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Adventurers!

Dunewalker Mage carts broke down while transporting sandwurm eggs to a secure location. Each Mage has created a shield to protect their precious cargo, but can only prolong the inevitable onslaught. Rush to provide support at locations across Brightwood, Ebonscale Reach, Edengrove, Mourningdale, and Brimstone Sands.

Team up with 10+ players (recommended player level is 60+) to defend sandwurm eggs from waves of Sulfur Elementals for a Mini-Devourer hat skin, housing item, and more on February 4, 2025 until February 24, 2025. There are a few updates from the last siege; all existing event gear drops now scale to 700 Gear Score and players now have a chance to obtain 710 Gear Score items each day. 

[b]Standard Rewards[/b]

Face increasingly difficult waves of Sulfur Elementals, including the Remnant of the Unmaker, while the Mage recovers. Clear out every enemy to earn rewards based on your results. There is no daily limit for standard rewards, unless otherwise noted.

1 Egg Defended

Successfully defend 1 egg to receive the following rewards:
[list]
[*] 1 GS700 procedural weapon or armor piece 
[*] Some level appropriate consumables 
[*] A chance at some random loot including refining resources, perk items, rare resources, or crafting schematics
[*] a 50% chance to earn 1 Obsidian Gypsum (standard 3x loot limit)
[/list]
2 Eggs Defended

Save 2 eggs to net the following rewards:
[list]
[*] 1-2 GS700 procedural weapons or armor pieces
[*] Some level appropriate consumables 
[*] A chance at some random loot including refining resources, perk items, rare resources, or crafting schematics
[*] a 80% chance to earn 1 Obsidian Gypsum (standard 3x loot limit)
[/list]
3 Eggs Defended

Complete a perfect run for even better spoils, including the following rewards:
[list]
[*] 2 GS700 procedural weapons or armor pieces
[*] Some level appropriate consumables 
[*] A chance at some random loot including refining resources, perk items, rare resources, or crafting schematics
[*] Guaranteed 1 Obsidian Gypsum (standard 3x loot limit)
[/list]
Bonus Rewards 

Bonus rewards can be earned up to three times daily. This limit will reset at 5 AM local time. For example, if you collect your third set of bonus rewards at 4:58 AM, you’ll be able to get more at 5:01 AM.

Guaranteed 1 GS700 event-only procedural weapon, always rolls Epic+:
[list]
[*] Weapon Appropriate Attribute
[*] Guaranteed Gem Slot
[*] Enchanted
[*] Random Perk
[*] Random Perk
[/list]
 Guaranteed 1 GS700 event-only procedural armor piece, always rolls Epic+:
[list]
[*] Random Weight-Appropriate Single Stat Attribute
[*] Chitin in Gem Slot
[*] Health
[*] Random Perk 
[*] Random Perk 
[*] Guaranteed 100 Dark Matter
[/list]
A 30% chance for 1 of 6 pieces of GS710 Legendary Named gear:
[list]
[*] Oasis of Life (Life Staff)
[*] Heatstroke (Blunderbuss)
[*] Stalker's Sand (Hatchet)
[*] Dunewinds (Ice Gauntlet)
[*] Sun Seal (Light Chest)
[*] Bloodwalker (Light Footwear)
[/list]
25% chance for the Sandwurm Egg of the Protector (Housing Item)
     *Limit: one per event

 2% chance for the Mini Shah Neshen Helm Skin
    Your chance of getting this skin will increase with each successful run, to a maximum of 30 boxes for a guaranteed roll.
    *Limit: one per event

Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Aeternum.

notes.title: Season of Conquerors Release Notes
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/5cJuEogEAsyrS0ESXsX3XE/f22f6a5b3e558071090b168fb7207ff9/NWA_HercyneWeapon_HatchetMusket_Premium_S7Article_1920x1080_CT-000015036.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Adventurers!

New World: Aeternum Season of the Conquerors downtime will begin at 5:00 a.m. PT (1:00 p.m. UTC) on January 21 and last approximately 2 hours.

[h3]What’s New in Season 7?[/h3]
Seasonal Worlds: A Fresh Start
Introducing Seasonal Worlds, a brand-new system that reimagines the Aeternum experience with unique game rules, items, and abilities each season.

[h3]
Season 7 Seasonal World Theme: PvP[/h3]
Players flag for PvP starting at Level 15.
Discover new resources and gear with powerful perks—but beware, these items drop upon death.
At the end of the season, Seasonal Worlds will close, and players can transfer their characters to a permanent world of their choice.

[h3]New Outpost Rush Map “Coral Divide” Preview Weekend[/h3]
Get a sneak peek at the brand new Outpost Rush map “Coral Divide” during a special preview weekend. A central trench divides the battlefield and houses NPCs. Build bridges to create new pathways, opening up strategic opportunities for your team.

[h3]M3 Expedition Upgrades[/h3]
Explore endgame PvE content with significant changes to improve your dungeon runs:
[list]
[*] Unified Mutations: Use one gear loadout across all M3 mutated expeditions.
[*] Activity Finder Integration: Matchmake for M3 Expeditions seamlessly.
[*] Upgraded Rewards: Conquer challenges and collect better loot than ever before.
[*] Bug fixes for Expeditions include:
[*] Resolved AI movement issues (e.g., Wind Chill interaction with Nereid).
[*] Fixed targeting issues for the Void Destroyer in Tempest Heart.
[*] Improved mechanics and enemy interactions across all expeditions.
[/list]
[h3]Artifacts: Collect Powerful New Weapons and Gear[/h3]
Season 7 introduces several new artifacts with unique abilities to enhance your arsenal:
[list]
[*] Void Gauntlet: Fracture - Heal 100% more health and deal 50% more damage with Essence Rupture. Unlock by defeating Tribunal Ice Mammoth, Ipomoea, and 20 Frozen Varangians in the Glacial Tarn.
[*] Life Staff: Heceta - Grant -30% damage absorption with Light Touch after casting a Life Staff ability. Complete the Heceta Canyon Questline to unlock.
[*] Ice Gauntlet: Otzi - Inflict Frostburn by breaking Entomb, slowing enemies and dealing damage over time. Found in Icewood Caverns by defeating Frostbound Howler.
[*] Fire Staff: Burnatator - Sacrifice damage for increased burn effects (15% over 5 seconds). Collect Ember Flames in Scorched Dunes.
[*] Bow: Aconite - Deal 15% more damage to poisoned enemies. Unlock via the Venom Questline in Jungle Wilds.
[*] Rapier: Dorgort’s Blade - Apply stacking burn effects with heavy melee attacks. Defeat Dorgort in the Volcanic Lair to earn Lava Tip.
[*] Earring: Justice - Automatically recharge healing potions after 20 hits (90-second cooldown). Complete the Alchemist Trials in the Forbidden Labs.
[*] Musket: Shrapnel - Cause enemies to bleed on headshots. Earn by defeating the War Machine Captain in Ashen Barracks.
[/list]
[h3]Seasonal Events[/h3]
Enjoy in-game events throughout Season 7:
[list]
[*] Siege of Sulfur: Team up with 10+ max-level players to defend sandwurm eggs from waves of Sulfur Elementals.
[*] Legacy of Crassus: Battle Crassus and his cyclopean minions to claim upleveled rewards up to Gear Score 700.
[*] Rabbit’s Revenge: Hunt mischievous corrupted rabbits for exciting loot in this fan-favorite event.
[/list]
[h3]Season Pass Rewards[/h3]
Unlock exclusive rewards with the Season 7 Pass, featuring Free and Premium Tracks.
Free Track:
[list]
[*] Hercyne-themed tool skins, mask skins, and tent skins
[*] New artifacts: Otzi and Heceta
[*] Transmog Tokens, dyes, and consumables
[/list]
Premium Track (20,000 Marks of Fortune):
[list]
[*] Everything in the Free Track, plus Hercyne-themed weapon and armor skins
[*] Two new emotes, four Transmog Tokens, and rare resources
[*] Additional boosters and dyes
[/list]

This update delivers critical fixes, polished mechanics, and improved player experiences. For the full relaase notes head [url=https://www.newworld.com/en-us/game/releases/season-of-conquerers]here[/url].

notes.title: New World: Aeternum Update 1.1.4
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/3qlt57EVAMFm8WaJf2leTk/753a18894fb600b8b7e34bd6aef3a20c/NWA_WinterConvergence_Settlement_TreeOfLight_740x416_Final_CT-000014536.jpg[/img]

[h3]Greetings, Adventurers![/h3]

New World: Aeternum Update 1.1.4 downtime will begin at 5:00 a.m. PT (1:00 p.m. UTC) on December 10 and last approximately 1.5 hours. Get ready to embrace the holiday magic—Winter Convergence Festival has returned to Aeternum! This seasonal event brings festive quests, exclusive rewards, and snowy landscapes to explore.

Check out the full release notes, including other notable fixes, below.

[h2]Winter Convergence Festival[/h2]
The Winter Wanderer has returned, spreading joy and tasks across Aeternum. Visit Winter Villages in Everfall, Monarch’s Bluffs, Weaver’s Fen, and Brightwood to exchange Winter Tokens for unique seasonal rewards. Take on festive daily quests, discover scattered gifts, and defeat the wintry Frigid Folk to collect rare items.
[list]
[*] Winter Villages: Explore festive hubs in key territories.
[*] Exclusive Rewards: Unlock holiday-themed armor skins, weapon skins, housing decorations, and emotes.
[*] Winter Wanderer Quests: Assist the Wanderer in restoring seasonal balance.
[/list]
The Winter Convergence Festival is only here for a limited time, so join the fun before the snow melts.

[h2]Hive of the Gorgons[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed the Nagas in Hive of Gorgon's maze to be killed with the contagious upheaval perk.
[*] Fixed an issue that would occasionally prevent Typhon from properly transitioning from phase one to phase two.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed Echidna to be pushed by the wind chill ability from Ice Gauntlet.
[*] Fixed an issue where Fungal Infection could be transferred to enemies.
[/list]

[h2]Combat[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in which occasionally the effects from a prior ability would appear the next time the ability was performed.
[*] Fire Staff: Fixed an issue that allowed looping abilities to loop indefinitely.
[*] Hatchet: Fixed an issue that could lead to a faster than intended attack speed.
[*] Heartrunes: Fixed an issue where Heartrunes could allow abilities to reset their start up.
[*] Heartrunes: Fixed an issue that allowed faster attacks than intended.
[*] Blunderbuss: Fixed an issue that allowed the Blunderbuss basic attack to fire faster than intended.
[*] Fixed an issue where the elemental band Artifact perk could trigger off of damage over time.
[*] Fixed an issue where Nature's Wrath could sometimes cause Empowers to last indefinitely.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Corrupted Acolyte's summoned corruption mines sometimes wouldn't deal damage.
[/list]

[h2]World Experience[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the Gleamite Meteor to not provide enough Gleamite chunks and shards.
[*] Fixed the daily reset for the quests Long Live the Queen and They Dryad Promenade in Reekwater, as those quests had been set up in such a way that they were not properly gating players who had already completed them on the same day.
[/list]

[h2]Notable Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare startup crash in the renderer when game settings data was not successfully loaded.
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when transitioning between Expeditions and game worlds.
[*] Fixed an issue in the PC DX12 Beta that could cause a framerate drop after changing video options.
[/list]

[h2]Mounts[/h2]
[list]
[*] Mounts now consume stamina when jumping while dashing.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed mount jump from stopping to increase speed.
[/list]

[h2]Economy, Progression, and Gear[/h2]
[list]
[*] Re-enabled the ability to mass-salvage Azoth Vials.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the Deckhands Promotion Earring to have the weapon functionality of the Jasper gem's retaliate effect instead of armor.
[/list]

[h2]UI/UX/Social[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused platform invites to fail when sent cross region.
[*] Fixed an issue that blocked social features.
[*] Entering a game mode from within a house will no longer leave you in a broken house state when you exit the game mode.
[*] Changed the world transfer purchase in the store to no longer refer to region transfers.
[/list]

Whether you’re collecting festive rewards or exploring snowy landscapes, there’s something for everyone. Jump into Aeternum and make this season unforgettable. 

Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Aeternum.

notes.title: New World Aeternum: Post-Launch Dev Update
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/3Vw18Ii2ogw8X0jAfDwAr7/46f312eba175719c7ec22ab64e6a5f96/sunset.jpg[/img]
Greeting, Adventurers!

Welcome to our first post-launch New World: Aeternum Dev Update! It’s been a very exciting past few weeks since the release of New World: Aeternum with so many new and returning players arriving on the island.

In today’s update, we’re going to walk through what to expect from the future of New World: Aeternum. We’ve been listening to players and we know how important it is for the community to be informed of and understand what is planned for the game. We’re excited to share a first look at what is coming down the road in the near term, but also, we wanted to be transparent about some of the exciting content that’s a little further out. We’ve heard you loud and clear and have been thinking hard about how we deliver updates and give more visibility into not only what the team is actively working on, but also what is in early development, and even some of our very early ideas that we’re exploring in the studio.

To that end, we are releasing a new roadmap format that we are calling a Living Roadmap. Our goal with the Living Roadmap is to keep our players informed as much as we can along the way, specifically covering three categories of feature development:
[list]
[*] Next Season (short-term): What is coming in the next seasonal update.
[*] In-Development (mid-term): What is in active development and will be coming in upcoming seasons. These items will not necessarily be available in the immediate next season, but within a season or two.
[*] In-Exploration: Ideas the Dev team is discussing or exploring. These are features we’ve heard from players would be exciting for them, or that we just think would be good additions to the game. Some might move to in-development, some might fall off altogether if they are determined to not be feasible or are no-longer of interest to our players, but we want to show what we’re investigating here in the studio.
[/list]
There is a lot of information here to digest, and we will keep refining this process as we go. We look forward to your thoughts!

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/2DdkEKJqVb0FY8F2nyIZ7R/bcce984fc64965494ac6a2e2c53a5a17/EN_NWA_Roadmap_Update_-24_1920x1080.jpg[/img]
We sat down with Scot, Dave V, Katy, Dan, and some other faces from the team to dive deep into Season 7. Introducing Seasonal Worlds, a dynamic new way to experience the game. The first Seasonal World will focus on PvP. There will also be a new Outpost Rush map preview, daily solo trials, and the comeback of popular seasonal events, and also talk more about what is shown in the new roadmap. Watch here and read more below!
[previewyoutube=8XW0pK7dwPQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Season 7[/h2]
Get ready for an exciting new year with Season 7, launching in January 2025. It will introduce Seasonal Worlds starting with a PvP focused world, more daily solo trials, updates to Mutated Expeditions, and a preview for a new Outpost Rush map.

[h3]Seasonal World 1: PvP Focus[/h3]
Seasonal Worlds are dynamic, limited-time servers designed to deliver unique gameplay experiences. The first of which features always-on PVP, special loot that drops on death, and unique items. Rewards and progression will carry over after the season ends, ensuring their efforts are never lost. Look forward to learning all about how this World will work in a future article.

[h3]New Outpost Rush (OPR) Map Preview[/h3]
A new Outpost Rush map is coming, offering players a fresh battlefield to conquer and test their skills in this strategic PVP game mode. Outpost Rush is a team-based competition where players gather resources, capture objectives, and outmaneuver opponents in epic battles for dominance and rewards. This new map will have a preview weekend during Season 7, so keep an eye out for more details.

[h3]Mutated Expedition Upgrades[/h3]
Unified Mutations will remove the need for multiple gear sets, add matchmaking for M3, and improve rewards for these challenging Expeditions.

[h3]Daily Solo Trials[/h3]
Solo Trials provide an exciting opportunity for players to test their individual skill, strategy, and mastery in high-stakes battles against iconic bosses. In Season 7, three brand-new challenges take the spotlight: A Mother’s Dream featuring Empress Zhou, Tempest’s Mind starring Isabella, and Daichi Soto, offering fresh, thrilling encounters that push players to their limits.

[h3]Combat Balance Updates[/h3]
Season 7 will bring balance updates, starting with some changes to reduce time to kill in PvP and adjustments to weapons like the blunderbuss and hatchet. More information will come as we get closer to release.

[h3]New Artifacts and Perks[/h3]
Season 7 introduces eight brand-new artifacts to enhance gameplay and strategy, including seven powerful weapons and one unique accessory: an earring.

[h3]Seasonal Events[/h3]
Events like Legacy of Crassus and Rabbit’s Revenge are making a return, offering new players a chance to experience these seasonal favorites. Certain events, like the Legacy of Crassus, will receive enhanced rewards beyond level 700. Expect additional details at a later date.

[h2]Looking Ahead: In Development Features[/h2]
The Dev team is bringing fresh excitement to New World: Aeternum and is excited to share in-development features as part of our new Living Roadmap. These include more types of Seasonal Worlds, a revamped Invasion mode, new PvP modes, additional maps for existing modes, and endgame improvements such as expanded wars. We are excited to share that we are working on long-requested updates such as global storage and the Barbershop. The team is also working to up-level zones such as Reekwater and update reputation systems. The journey ahead promises to be unforgettable.

[h2]In Exploration: Big Content Additions[/h2]
This section of the roadmap highlights early concepts and ideas that could shape New World: Aeternum’s future in exciting and unexpected ways. From new weapons, a new zone, and new PvE modes to a completely new trade skill, these potential additions aim to keep gameplay fresh and engaging. The team is also exploring new features like company halls with storage, a siege system, and unique exploration and collection systems, all designed to deepen the endgame and bring new dimensions to the New World: Aeternum experience.

Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Aeternum.

notes.title: New World: Aeternum Update 1.1.2
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/1Pv2KoQD8iobaf3rpUx6Yy/c6da23d5e5868064f5bfdc6b61deb1f9/NW_NightveilHallow_Screenshots_CostumesCauldron_Final_1920x1080_CT-002723.jpg[/img]
Greetings, Adventurers!

New World: Aeternum Update 1.1.2 downtime will begin at 11:00PM PT (7:00AM UTC) on November 5 and last approximately 2 hours. Baalphazu has been banished back to the darkness, marking the end of Nightveil Hallow. This update also includes rendering changes as well as fixes to some quests. Check out the full release notes, including other notable fixes, below.

[h3]World Experience[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused players to receive more PvP Experience than intended in the Cursed Mists zone.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented progress in the Syndicate: Trial of the Scrivener quest and Faction rank advancement.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused several repeatable Expedition quests to not contribute to the "Repeat Offender" Season Journey task.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused players to phase into certain objects when accessing menus while vaulting.
[/list]
[h3]Rendering[/h3]
[list]
[*] PC DX12 Beta Client:
[*] Added FSR native resolution TAA (Temporal Anti-Aliasing) only mode
[*] Added FSR sharpness control
[*] Improved the stability of our DX12 renderer
[*] FSR - Console/PC DX12:
[*] Improved visual quality of the FSR upscale
[*] Fixed rendering artifacts that could occur during FSR upscaling
[*] Fixed an issue in which emissive materials were not properly rendering, causing an unintended blue glow on several weapons.
[*] Fixed an issue in which some weapon effects would appear overly blown-out, especially in heavy combat scenarios.
[*] Fixed Depth-of-Field shimmering in certain lighting conditions (most notable during in-game cinematics).
[/list]
[h3]Notable Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Identified and fixed a rare crash that could occur if a player's client has a corrupted install which causes certain texture files to be invalid. In these cases we will instead render a basic white texture, allowing players to proceed into the game. Players who see this white texture should validate their installation files afterwards to try to correct any prior installation issues.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented players on PC from progressing if they had Old Wounds ready for turn in before the release of New World: Aeternum.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the 3v3 Arena end of match UI to not display properly.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented nameplates from appearing. 
[/list]
Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Aeternum.

notes.title: New World: Aeternum Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/70yzDV4gR2kLdpssSLJ6Ig/1d1cb52565d5c2499562cc1ee02127d7/NW_NightveilHallow_Screenshots_Costumes_Final_1920x1080_CT-002723.jpg[/img]
Greetings, Adventurers!

New World: Aeternum Update 1.1.0 downtime will begin at 5:00 a.m. PT (12:00 p.m. UTC) on October 22 and last approximately 1.5 hours. Banish the shadowy demon back to the darkness, don unique costumes, and trick-or-treat for unique candy rewards during the Nightveil Hallow event.

Check out the full release notes, including various bug fixes, below.

[h2]Nightveil Hallow[/h2]
Shapes in the mist! Shrieks in the night! The demon Baalphazu, Marquis of Terror, and his horde of ghoulish Pumpkinites are spreading a living nightmare across Aeternum. Aid Salvatore the Mad in his quest to banish these foul terrors and collect a bounty of Nightveil Hallow rewards.

[url=https://www.newworld.com/en-us/news/articles/nightveil-hallow-announcement]Nightveil Hallow returns[/url] on October 22 through November 5. You can also purchase event-specific items in the Event Shop.

[h3]World Experience[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rendering issue in Ebonscale Reach that caused flags to become discolored on HDR displays.
[*] Improved the blending of shadows after transitioning cameras (e.g., during in-game cinematics), game modes, and fast traveling.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the chapter 4 task "The Trial of the Devourer I" to not be completable. This task was previously disabled.
[*] Fixed a rare issue that caused a crash when when crossing boundaries between certain areas in the open world.
[/list]
[h3]AI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Ifrit's Flame wave attack damage to not properly scale based on the mutation level.
[*] Decreased Ifrit's Flame wave attack damage in the Empyrean Forge Expedition and Mutation 1 difficulty.
[/list]
[h3]Game Modes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the player to receive a second, non-usable Outpost Rush cache after matches.
[*] Players can no longer enter Fort Luna without using the doors in Outpost Rush.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented players from opening the Carry Bonus Cache in Expeditions and Mutators. This will now award the player 100 Coin.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed players to enter the battleground during the prep phase in War.
[/list]
[h3]UX/UI/Social[/h3]
[list]
[*] Certain territory related notifications will no longer appear during the First Time Player Tutorial.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused house payments to occasionally fail.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused claimable achievement notifications to not appear when logging in.
[/list]
Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in the shadows of Aeternum throughout Nightveil Hallow.

notes.title: New World: Aeternum is Now Live
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/j95d1p8hsuun/2qBOnicfolhm5ACRcYcVUt/e3a2a7644a9a9cae98548904c89884cb/NWA_KeyArt-Standard-Iconic_WEB_1920x1080.jpg[/img]
Greetings, Adventurers!

Explore a cursed island plagued by mystery now that [i]New World: Aeternum[/i] is live and every world is open. In search of rumored riches on the Eternal Isle of Aeternum, you shipwreck and are plunged into the depths of an immortal spiral. Its strange inhabitants pulled in by the winds of opportunity, or so you thought. Learn the ways of the island’s increasingly savage, supernatural cycle and forge your story to uncover the truth lurking behind Aeternum’s perpetual conflicts.

We’re thrilled for players to discover supernatural secrets together across PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S! Check out our launch trailer, plus some words of welcome from [i]New World: Aeternum[/i] Game Director, Scot Lane.

[previewyoutube=FOMhUJitBD4;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]I’m so happy to welcome you all to the shores of Aeternum, some of you for the first time and others returning for another adventure.

Over the past 3 years of live development, we’ve not only added an incredible amount of content but also learned a ton. The feedback from players has helped us make so many decisions and streamline gameplay to where we are now.

We’ve worked so hard to make New World: Aeternum sing with a controller and play well on console and spent the better part of the last year optimizing, polishing and readying Aeternum for this next phase. On top of that, we’ve added more endgame content including our first raid, the Hive of Gorgons, which is the culmination of our PvE experience, and a Free-For-All PvP zone the Cursed Mists, where adventurers can test their skills and grab awesome loot! We’ve also rebuilt the way we tell the story to really immerse players in the world.

So with that, we are extremely excited to embark on this journey together. Launch is just the starting point and we have big plans for where we want to go next. We will continue to listen and use your feedback to inform our future updates. A big thanks to our returning players and again, welcome to our new players across all platforms – we are so happy and excited to have you experience Aeternum!

I will part with a bit of advice, take your time and savor the journey – no need to rush through it.

I can’t wait to see you in Aeternum![/i]

Scot Lane

Game Director, [i]New World: Aeternum[/i]

[h2]Community Platforms[/h2]
[previewyoutube=qK8jtTMHCRU;full][/previewyoutube]
From venturing into Expeditions alongside your team to solve puzzles and vanquish powerful enemies, to joining a Company vying for control of Aeternum through Influence Races and Wars, [i]New World: Aeternum[/i] values, emphasizes, and celebrates player interaction and community.

You can text and voice chat with other players in-game, but we want to make sure you have the tools to connect with other players, and our team, outside of the game. Below you will find ways to connect with the [i]New World: Aeternum[/i] community, plus how to get involved if you’re interested in joining our Creator Program.

The [url=https://www.newworld.com/en-us/forward-link?id=discord]New World: Aeternum Discord[/url] server was built for Amazon Games staff members to host events, Q&As, and talk to the community. Say hello, meet other players, and provide feedback on how to make Aeternum better for every type of player.

Follow our social accounts and [url=https://www.newworld.com/]www.newworld.com[/url] for exclusive content, community highlights, and the latest information on all things [i]New World: Aeternum[/i].

[h3]Creator Program[/h3]
The [i]New World: Aeternum[/i] Creator Program empowers you to collaborate with the [i]New World: Aeternum[/i] team and other creative members of the community. Whether you’re a streamer, YouTuber, wiki author, cosplayer, artist, musician, or anyone else who makes something to contribute to the love of [i]New World: Aeternum[/i], we want to find ways to support you. There are no requirements to apply other than a desire to create great [i]New World: Aeternum[/i] content. Learn more and sign up on our [url=https://www.newworld.com/en-us/community/creator-program]Creator program[/url] page.

[h2]Trials of Aeternum[/h2]
[previewyoutube=BVLsq7j7AKY;full][/previewyoutube]
Embark on a thrilling journey with challenges spanning the shores to Shattered Mountain now during the Trials of Aeternum event. Join forces with your fellow PC, PlayStation 5, or Xbox Series X|S Adventurers and turn weekly achievements into highly coveted, exclusive rewards themed around the foundations of Aeternum.
[list]
[*] Forest Green rewards for our brave Xbox Series X|S Adventurers
[*] River Blue rewards for our daring PlayStation 5 Adventurers
[*] Mountain Red rewards for our fearless PC Adventurers
[/list]
This 3-week-long event will feature themed challenges designed to guide your team through the supernatural secrets, threats, and fortunes lurking across Aeternum. As you grow in power, you can track your team’s challenges, progress, and hard-earned spoils on the dedicated Trials of Aeternum page. The island’s increasingly savage, supernatural cycle is not for the faint of heart, but it favors those who seek opportunity. Conquer the Trials of Aeternum to seize yours!

Check out our [url=https://www.newworld.com/en-us/news/articles/trials-of-aeternum]announcement article[/url] for additional information on rewards, challenges, and more.

Thanks for being part of the [i]New World: Aeternum[/i] community! Look forward to additional content, updates, and ways to enjoy [i]New World[/i] in the future. We’ll see you in Aeternum.
